summary: Russia launched a massive wave of reactive UAVs and Geran-5 rockets targeting multiple Ukrainian regions including Kyiv, Vinnytsia, Cherkasy, Poltava, Mykolaiv, Zhytomyr, and Chernihiv. Russian forces advanced near Kalenyky and Bilytsky while liberating Shirokoye, Shevchenkovo in Kharkiv region and Novoandreevka in Zaporizhzhia region. Trump claimed Ukraine and Russia agreed to halt strikes on energy infrastructure, though Kyiv and Moscow have not officially confirmed.
key_points: Russia launched reactive UAVs from Dnipropetrovsk, Black Sea, Chernihiv, and other directions targeting Kyiv, Vinnytsia, Cherkasy, Poltava, Mykolaiv, Zhytomyr regions (Source: @mon1tor_ua/74511)
Geran-5 rockets struck Zhytomyr, Bila Tserkva (station/warehouses), Darnytsky district Kyiv, Vasylkiv area, and Nyzy Sady/TEC-5 (Source: @mon1tor_ua/74534)
Russian forces advanced near Kalenyky and Bilytsky per DeepState map update (Source: @DeepStateUA/23831)
Russian army liberated Shirokoye and Shevchenkovo in Kharkiv region and Novoandreevka in Zaporizhzhia region (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33245)
Trump stated Ukraine and Russia agreed not to strike energy infrastructure; Zelensky confirmed readiness if partners guarantee Russian compliance (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33257)
EC approved additional €6.1B for Ukraine ammunition, drones, EW, air defense including PAC-3 for Patriot systems (Source: @tass_agency/395367)
Russian air defense shot down 173 Ukrainian UAVs over Russian regions and Black Sea (Source: @tass_agency/395372)
Ukraine receives $841M World Bank budget support for pension expenditures (Source: @UkraineNow/84092)

sections.executive_summary: Russia conducted a large-scale drone and missile barrage across central, northern, and southern Ukraine overnight, employing reactive UAVs and Geran-5 rockets against Kyiv, Vinnytsia, Cherkasy, Poltava, Mykolaiv, Zhytomyr, and Chernihiv regions. Russian ground forces made tactical gains near Kalenyky and Bilytsky while liberating three settlements in Kharkiv and Zaporizhzhia regions. Diplomatic developments emerged as Trump claimed an energy infrastructure ceasefire agreement between Kyiv and Moscow, though neither capital has officially confirmed.

points: Ukrainian air defense engaged reactive UAV groups across Kyiv region (3 groups), Chernihiv region (1 group), Vinnytsia, Cherkasy, Poltava, Mykolaiv, Zhytomyr, and Kirovohrad regions per eRadar monitoring data (Source: @eRadarrua/113275).

Geran-5 rockets struck multiple targets including Zhytomyr city, Bila Tserkva railway station and warehouse facilities, Darnytsky district of Kyiv, Vasylkiv/Hlevakha/Kalynivka area, and Nyzy Sady/TEC-5 infrastructure (Source: @mon1tor_ua/74534).
Ukraine received $841 million in World Bank budget support earmarked for pension expenditure reimbursement (Source: @UkraineNow/84092).

Zelensky stated Ukraine is ready to halt strikes on Russian energy infrastructure if partners secure reliable, long-term guarantees that Russia will cease attacks on Ukrainian energy facilities, critical infrastructure, and food supply routes (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33257).
War cost projected at $190 million per day in 2026, a $50 million increase from 2024 due to army expansion and military family support obligations (Source: @UkraineNow/84095).

Russian forces launched reactive UAVs from multiple vectors: Dnipropetrovsk region toward Poltava, Black Sea toward southern Mykolaiv, Chernihiv region toward Kyiv region, and Bryansk region toward Chernihiv region (Source: @mon1tor_ua/74511).
Russian tactical aviation conducted guided aerial bomb strikes on Dnipropetrovsk and Zaporizhzhia regions, and on northern Sumy region (Source: @kpszsu/78239).
Russian air defense reported destroying 173 Ukrainian UAVs over Russian regions and Black Sea waters in a single day (Source: @tass_agency/395372).
Russian pilots dropped FAB-250 bombs on AFU positions near Preobrazhenka in Zaporizhzhia region (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33231).

Kremlin spokesperson Peskov welcomed Trump's call for Ukraine to stop strikes on Russian refineries but refused to confirm whether Russia would halt strikes on Ukrainian infrastructure (Source: @UkraineNow/84094).
Russian forces liberated Shirokoye and Shevchenkovo villages in Kharkiv region according to Russian sources (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33245).
Troops from the "Dnepr" force grouping liberated Novoandreevka settlement in Zaporizhzhia region (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33247).
DeepState map update indicates enemy advancement near Kalenyky and Bilytsky positions (Source: @DeepStateUA/23831).
Russian guided aerial bombs struck Dnipropetrovsk and Zaporizhzhia regions (Source: @kpszsu/78239).
Reactive UAVs detected moving from Chernihiv region toward Slavutych and Ripky, continuing in southwesterly direction (Source: @kpszsu/78245).
Strike UAVs operating in northern Chernihiv region on/past Ripky moving southwest (Source: @kpszsu/78245).
Reconnaissance activity reported on Kyiv and Zhytomyr regions; last reactive guided UAV tracked in Vinnytsia region Haisyn district heading toward Kyiv region (Source: @eRadarrua/113270).
Reactive UAVs from Bryansk region targeting Chernihiv region, Chernihiv district (Source: @mon1tor_ua/74511).
Reactive UAVs launched from Black Sea waters targeting southern Mykolaiv region, Mykolaiv district (Source: @mon1tor_ua/74511).
Russian strike drones hit a dry cargo ship in Odesa port per Russian state media summary (Source: @tass_agency/395374).
Guided aerial bomb strikes conducted on Zaporizhzhia region by Russian tactical aviation (Source: @kpszsu/78239).
FAB-250 bombs dropped on AFU positions near Preobrazhenka in Zaporizhzhia region (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33231).

Massive overnight drone wave: reactive UAV groups tracked across Kyiv (3 groups), Chernihiv (1), Vinnytsia, Cherkasy, Poltava, Mykolaiv, Zhytomyr, Kirovohrad, Sumy (strike UAVs 4 groups), Kharkiv (strike UAVs 2 groups) regions (Source: @eRadarrua/113275).
Geran-5 rocket strikes reported on Zhytomyr, Bila Tserkva (station/warehouses), Darnytsky district Kyiv, Vasylkiv area, Nyzy Sady/TEC-5, and TC Republic (Source: @mon1tor_ua/74534).
Reactive UAVs from Dnipropetrovsk region toward Poltava region, Poltava district; from Black Sea toward Mykolaiv region; from Chernihiv region toward Kyiv region (Source: @mon1tor_ua/74511).

sections.threat_assessment: The scale and geographic spread of Russia's overnight drone campaign — employing both reactive UAVs and Geran-5 rockets against population centers and infrastructure across central, northern, and southern Ukraine — indicates sustained long-range strike capacity and intent to overwhelm air defenses. Simultaneous tactical gains in Kharkiv and Zaporizhzhia sectors suggest Russia is maintaining offensive pressure on multiple axes. The reported energy infrastructure ceasefire discussion introduces diplomatic complexity but lacks verification; Peskov's refusal to commit to reciprocal restraint suggests Russia may seek asymmetric advantage. Ukraine's accelerated counter-drone development and Western PAC-3 procurement signal preparation for prolonged aerial attrition.
sections.regional_response: Poland's Sikorski advocated NATO exercises near Kaliningrad to divert Russian forces from Ukraine, reflecting Eastern European pressure for alliance burden-sharing. Germany's €3.4B Tomahawk purchase for Bundeswehr — explicitly not for Ukraine — highlights European rearmament decoupled from direct Ukrainian support. Italy's Salvini linked Russian gas resumption to conflict resolution, indicating Southern European economic impatience. EC's €6.1B Ukraine package including PAC-3 missiles demonstrates continued but calibrated military aid. Latvia's reconnaissance drones near Belarus border show Baltic vigilance but no direct escalation.
sections.intelligence_notes: The simultaneous tracking of reactive UAVs from five distinct launch vectors (Dnipropetrovsk, Black Sea, Chernihiv, Bryansk, and internal Ukrainian regions) suggests sophisticated Russian command-and-control for distributed drone operations. Geran-5 strikes on specific infrastructure — Bila Tserkva railway/warehouses, Nyzy Sady/TEC-5, Darnytsky district — indicate targeting of logistics and energy nodes. DeepState's confirmed advances near Kalenyky/Bilytsky align with Russian liberation claims in Kharkiv/Zaporizhzhia, suggesting coherent front-wide pressure. Trump's ceasefire claim precedes any official Kyiv/Moscow confirmation, creating information operation risk. Ukraine's $190M/day war cost and A100 fuel at 100 UAH/L reflect mounting domestic economic strain.
